rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rent control applies to fully covered units: most multifamily units built before 1980, single-family homes with tenancies that began before 1996, and rooming houses. New construction after June 1980, newer single-family tenancies, most condominiums and certain federally subsidized units are registered but not subject to rent control.
rules.citation: Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.status_basis: Coverage guide describes the ordinance as in force.

exempt_if.text: New construction: units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980
Single-family home with a tenancy that began on or after January 1, 1996

exempt_if.name: tenancy_began_on_or_after_1996
exempt_if.text: tenancy began on or after January 1, 1996
Golden Duplex: duplex that was owner-occupied on December 31, 1979, and currently has an owner living in one of the units

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: owner living in one of the units
Tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018, on properties where one unit is an ADU

exempt_if.name: owner_shares_kitchen_or_bath
exempt_if.text: Unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant if the owner lived on the property at the time the tenancy started

exempt_if.name: university_housing
exempt_if.text: University rental units such as dormitories

exempt_if.name: specified_government_subsidy
exempt_if.text: Units with Section 202, Section 811, or project-based subsidies in a project with a HUD-insured or held mortgage

coverage.summary: Most multifamily units built before 1980 and pre-1996 single-family tenancies are fully covered by rent control.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Post-June 1980 new construction, newer single-family tenancies, condominiums, certain subsidized units, owner-occupied duplexes and ADU properties, shared-kitchen owner units, university housing and nonprofit cooperatives are not under rent control.

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction applies to both fully and partially covered units, including new construction after June 1980, newer single-family tenancies, condominiums and certain subsidized units. Only the listed exempt unit types are excluded.
